scenario: 今日基础设施这边，一条线在问服务时怎样少等最忙的卡，少被预填充块大小绑住；一条线把投机解码的草稿写得更省，或者让草稿先看例题再模拟，而不是硬解同一道题。还有人让模型自己决定何时压缩上下文，并给 Tenstorrent 芯片接上现成的 PyTorch 和 JAX 栈。有的系统按预填充和解码不同的瓶颈来平衡专家并行，有的把一份权重切成半比特档位来换能耗，也有人在消费级 GPU 上靠回收寄存器加快低比特注意力。分布式训练里的静默缺陷，则开始用对齐中间张量的办法来查，而不是只盯损失曲线。

papers.title: RankCast: Phase-Aware Rank Balancing in MoE Serving
papers.authors: Kaidi Fu, Xu-Hao Lu, Pingwei Sun, Jianchao Tan, Yuchen Xie, Xunliang Cai
papers.abstract: Modern large language model (LLM) inference increasingly adopts disaggregated architectures that separate Prefill (P) and Decode (D) phases. Meanwhile, Expert Parallelism (EP) has been widely adopted in large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model serving. However, load imbalance still slows down MoE inference because each layer must wait for the busiest EP rank. The main source of latency differs between prefill and decode. Prefill is compute-bound, and its MoE layers' latency is determined by the maximum token count of the busiest rank. At the same time, under moderate batch sizes, Decode is memory-bound, so the latency is dominated by the maximum active-expert count across ranks. To solve both problems under a unified framework, we present RankCast, a system that reduces rank-level maximum token counts during prefill and active-expert counts during decode. For every token, RankCast preserves the predicted Top-p experts and chooses the remaining k-p from its Top-L candidates (L > k). In p
papers.summary: MoE 推理里，专家并行会让每一层都等最忙的那张卡。预填充阶段受计算限制，瓶颈是最忙卡上的 token 数；在中等批量下，解码受访存限制，瓶颈则变成各卡上同时激活的专家数。训练时即使用了负载均衡，上线后冻结的路由器仍会碰到批次波动和领域漂移，真正卡住时延的是某一瞬间各张卡上的负载。RankCast 给每个 token 保住预测出的主要专家，其余名额再从更大的候选里分到较空的卡上：预填充时把灵活分配赶到负载更低的卡，解码时关掉最忙卡上的部分专家。计算和通信还能跟模型执行重叠。在 Qwen3-235B 和 Qwen3.5-397B 上，它消除了最忙卡上超过 75% 的多余预填充负载，预填充吞吐最多提高 19%，每输出 token 的解码时间最多降低 10%，质量损失不到一个百分点。

papers.title: PipeAxes: Decoupling Compute and Communication Granularities for Pipeline-Parallel LLM Serving
papers.authors: Xiaoqiang Guo, Yifan Lin, Yang Liu, Jianan Zhang, Yingqi Peng, Jiamei Lv, Yi Gao, Wei Dong
papers.abstract: Pipeline parallelism can serve long-context language models on PCIe servers and across heterogeneous GPU clusters. Existing engines split prefill into token chunks to limit decode stalls. The chunk size also sets the GPU batch width and the size of activation transfers between stages. Small chunks reload model weights more often. Large chunks can keep the GPU and the link busy long enough to delay interactive requests. PipeAxes runs wide prefill batches a few layers at a time so decodes can run between slices. A fused Triton Hadamard-INT4 codec compresses activations, which travel in independently sized row groups over parallel TCP sockets. The scheduler uses latency slack to choose batch width, slice depth, and row-group size. We evaluated PipeAxes in 97 replays covering 5,016 requests on A800, RTX 4090, and RTX 3090 GPUs. All 74 requests met their latency targets during a tenfold bandwidth swing. In a four-stage mixture-of-experts pipeline, PipeAxes served requests within their laten
papers.summary: 用流水线并行在 PCIe 服务器或异构 GPU 上跑长上下文时，现有引擎常把预填充切成 token 块，块大小同时决定了 GPU 批宽和级间激活传输量。块太小会反复装权重，块太大又会把交互请求堵住。PipeAxes 让较宽的预填充批一次只跑几层，好在切片之间插入解码，并用压缩后的激活在独立大小的行组里传输，调度再按时延余量选批宽、切片深度和行组大小。衡量标准是有多少请求同时满足首 token 时延、每输出 token 时延和尾部间隔。在四段 MoE 流水线上，它在时延目标内的服务速率达到校准后 Revisit-PP 的 23.3 倍。在混合的长上下文负载里，短请求的高分位首 token 时延从原生 vLLM 的 129.8 秒降到 512 毫秒。

papers.title: Any-Rate: Half-Bit Multi-Precision LLM Quantization with Coded Bit-Planes
papers.authors: Hoonki Lee, Haechan Shin, Hyuntaek Jung, Yeonu Choi, Sangyeob Kim
papers.abstract: Nested multi-precision quantization derives multiple precisions from a single checkpoint by reading only the leading bits of each weight, which makes it attractive for on-device deployment under varying memory and energy budgets. However, existing methods offer only integer bits, leaving large accuracy gaps between adjacent precisions and severe degradation at 2 bits. To address this, we propose Any-Rate, which serves 2-8 bits from one checkpoint, in half-bit steps over 2-4 bits. Any-Rate restricts some bit-planes to extended Hamming codewords in 8-weight blocks (0.5 bits per weight), shares one LUT per row across precisions, and encodes all precisions jointly with a separate target for each, reducing the loss from sharing bit-planes. Across four LLMs, Any-Rate achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among multi-precision methods at 2 and 3 bits, keeping 69% of FP16 accuracy at 2 bits, and is within one point of the best at 4 bits. It decodes about as fast as existing kernels, and an LPDDR
papers.summary: 端侧部署往往要在不同的内存和能耗预算之间切换精度，但一套权重里如果只能按整比特截取，相邻精度之间空隙大，到二比特时准度还会掉得很厉害。多个精度共用高位平面时，各自还要对齐不同目标，容易再损失一截准度。Any-Rate 从同一份检查点提供从二比特到八比特的多种精度，并在二到四比特之间按半比特分档。它把部分比特平面限制成短码字，各精度共用一行查找表，再为每个精度分别设目标，减轻共用高位平面带来的损失。在四个语言模型上，二比特仍能保住 FP16 准确度的 69%，在多精度方法里处于领先，解码速度也和现有内核差不多。按同等准确度估算，LPDDR 能耗最多可降 27%。

papers.title: DFly2: Turbocharging Long-Context Speculative Decoding by Sharing the Target's Sparsity
papers.authors: Hong Liu, Rui Cen, Junhan Shi, Lin Niu, Runzhi Fan, Zhaojing Zhou, Haodi Lei, Jiebin Zhang, Saiyong Yang, Junqiang Zheng, Zhenghai Xue, Guanghua Yu, Jianchen Zhu
papers.abstract: To avoid the quadratic cost of dense attention over long contexts, models such as DeepSeek-V4 and Hy4 have turned natively sparse, and speculative decoding, which matters most where decoding is slowest, increasingly runs on them. Their drafters, however, still keep a context cache of their own, over the whole prompt or a sliding window. Beyond memory, such a cache costs prefill time, prefix-cache hits and decode concurrency. Drafters that read the target's cache avoid one of their own, but settle only which cache, not which positions, and still read everything or a recent window. Neither rule is made for the query at hand, and computing a selection per query in the drafter would cost more as the context grows. Yet a natively sparse target already picks positions for each query, over a cache it keeps anyway. Both of the drafter's choices are therefore already made, and paid for, by the target: its cache and its selection. We measure how far one selection carries: made a step early, it s
papers.summary: 原生稀疏的长上下文模型已经在为目标查询挑选位置，投机解码的草稿模型却还常自己存一份上下文缓存，或者把整段、最近窗口都读一遍。自己建缓存会占显存、拖慢预填充，也会挤掉并发；按查询再算一遍选择，代价又会随上下文变长。DFly2 直接复用目标模型已经付过费的缓存和选择：每一层草稿只读配对目标层缓存里、被索引器挑中的那些位置，自己不再做打分、也不另建缓存。选择集合大小固定，却可以落在上下文的任意位置，因此长提示不必多读。在高并发、且每用户解码速度对齐时，服务 DS-V4.1-Flash 在长上下文和 agent 集合上的吞吐分别高出 62% 和 81%。

papers.title: How to Optimize NVFP4 Attention on NVIDIA RTX Blackwell Through Register Recycling
papers.abstract: Attention can be a major bottleneck when serving world foundation models, where long sequences make inference computationally demanding. On NVIDIA Hopper and...
papers.summary: 服务世界模型时，长序列会让注意力成为明显瓶颈。在 NVIDIA RTX Blackwell 上，NVFP4 能用四比特矩阵乘提高吞吐，但 softmax、数据搬运和中间结果之间的依赖，容易让 Tensor Core 空转。这类消费级芯片上的注意力又常常卡在矩阵乘，而不是 softmax。一种寄存器回收的排程把每个分数块拆成两个更窄的槽，在 softmax 量化之后立刻把寄存器让给下一块的计算，而不必再开一整块分数缓存。寄存器几乎占满，很难再同时放下下一块分数。在 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 上，NVFP4 注意力内核最多可加快 1.64 倍。Reactor 把优化后的内核接到世界模型的生产服务栈里，在 LongLive、Helios、OmniDreams 和 Cosmos 3 Nano 等负载上，端到端推理时延最多降低 15.34%。这套排程已合入 FlashInfer 主干。

papers.title: Asymmetric Speculative Decoding: Unlocking In-Context Learning in Draft Models
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding addresses Large Language Model (LLM) inference latency by first drafting and then verifying in parallel. Yet practical speedups fall far short of theoretical bounds, especially on reasoning tasks. We identify the root cause as task isomorphism: existing methods provide identical prompts to both models, forcing the draft model to solve problems beyond its capacity. This produces high rejection rates that eliminate parallelization gains. We discover that acceptance rates increase monotonically during generation, revealing a latent in-context learning (ICL) effect wherein the draft model progressively aligns with the target distribution by learning from verified tokens. Controlled experiments with varying context window sizes confirm this improvement stems from ICL-driven alignment rather than token difficulty. Motivated by this finding, we propose Asymmetric Speculative Decoding (AsymSpec), a training-free framework that decouples the prompts provided to draft and ta
papers.summary: 投机解码的实际加速常常远达不到理论上限，尤其在推理任务上。原因是草稿模型和目标模型拿到同一份提示，弱很多的草稿模型被迫自己解题，拒绝率一高，并行校验的好处就没了。即便草稿模型能做出对的答案，解题路径也可能和目标模型不一致，照样会被拒。接受率会随着生成过程单调上升，说明草稿模型其实在已通过校验的 token 上做上下文学习，逐渐对齐目标分布。AsymSpec 不再给两边同一份提示，而是给草稿模型提供任务相关的例题解法，把它的目标从解题改成模拟，并且不用重新训练。在推理、代码和摘要任务上，它相对自回归解码可加速 2.29 倍到 4.95 倍，也超过常规的投机解码。

papers.title: Looped Models are Fast Multi-Token Predictors
papers.authors: Ayhan Suleymanzade, Sean McLeish, Sehoon Kim, Jinwoo Kim, Antoine Bosselut
papers.abstract: Looped language models can adapt computation for predicting a token without a proportional rescaling in unique model parameters by adjusting the number of loops. This property has been used for self-speculative decoding, taking shallow loops as fast drafters and deep loops as verifiers, which is effective since drafting still uses full parameters. In this paper, we show that shallow loops can be also predictive of several future tokens and leverage this to drastically accelerate the inference of looped language models. To that end, we present Floodgates, a simple self-speculative decoding method that appends a block of mask tokens as a suffix and learns via low-rank adaptation to draft these tokens in parallel. Across seven models, five benchmarks, a range of batch sizes, and both greedy and sampled decoding, Floodgates is the fastest lossless decoding method in most cases, attaining up to 7.5x acceleration. Through analysis, we show that this speedup is enabled by all-depth training o
papers.summary: 循环语言模型靠调整循环次数来改变算力，而不必按比例增加独立参数。浅循环常被拿来当快速草稿，深循环再做校验，因为起草时仍能用上全部参数。其实浅循环也能一次预测后面好几个 token。Floodgates 在序列末尾接上一组掩码 token，用低秩适配学会并行起草这些位置，并且保持无损。加速还依赖循环模型在各深度上都受过训练，让浅草稿能借校验时已经算好的深层前缀缓存。在七个模型、五项基准以及多种批量和解码方式下，它在多数情况下是最快的无损解码方法，加速最多达到 7.5 倍。四次循环的浅模型上，单次循环起草平均最多可加快 5.1 倍；更高的加速出现在更深的模型和弹性起草上。

papers.title: Libtt: A Compiler and Runtime for Tenstorrent Processors
papers.abstract: Libtt brings the PyTorch and JAX ecosystem to Tenstorrent hardware. It implements PJRT, the interface through which XLA-based frameworks drive Google's TPUs, so JAX runs on it directly, PyTorch runs through TorchTPU, and software written for TPUs carries over with no changes except replacing custom kernels. Built on Tenstorrent's open-source compiler and runtime, libtt ships the entire stack, from the compiler to the multi-chip runtime, as a single shared library. It contains extensive fixes to the upstream Tenstorrent software to make existing PyTorch and JAX code work out of the box, and extensive new compiler optimizations to make it fast. It passes most of the JAX and TorchTPU test suites and runs SGLang, TorchTitan, and Miles, covering serving, fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning.
papers.summary: 要在 Tenstorrent 芯片上跑现成的 PyTorch 和 JAX 程序，关键是接到这些框架已经用来驱动 TPU 的那套接口。Libtt 实现了这套接口，JAX 可以直接跑，PyTorch 则经 TorchTPU 接入，为 TPU 写的软件除了替换自定义内核外不必改。它把编译器和多卡运行时打成一个共享库，修了大量上游问题，还补了新的编译优化，让已有代码尽量开箱能跑。多数 JAX 和 TorchTPU 测试能够通过，SGLang、TorchTitan 和 Miles 也能跑起来，覆盖服务、微调和强化学习。四卡上可以沿用 TorchTitan 的 TPU 训练路径，而不必改训练框架源码。小规模对照里，芯片上的起始损失和 CPU 能对到小数点后三位。融合注意力和损失之后，Qwen3-8B 在单卡上的训练吞吐从每秒 287 个 token 提到 435 个。

papers.title: Letting Models Manage Their Own Context: Where We Stand
papers.authors: Alessio Devoto, Avinash Vem, Tara Safavi, Sanjay Kariyappa, Yu-Hsuan Tseng
papers.abstract: Agent harnesses today manage context on the model's behalf: when the window fills, the harness triggers a compaction that summarizes the history. We study the alternative, model-driven context management, in which the model itself decides when and what to compact through a context API. We gave models control over their own context in \nooa, NVIDIA's open source agent harness, and compared the two strategies on document research and machine learning engineering across context budgets from 8K to 512K tokens. Models that use the context API effectively reach higher accuracy, often with fewer input tokens, especially at tight budgets: GPT 6.1 nearly triples its score at a 32K budget on OfficeQA Pro v2 (21\%~rightarrow~56\%), and Kimi gains with up to 41\% fewer input tokens. Models differ widely, however, in how often they use the API, how aggressively they compact, and when they start compacting, and prompt changes shift that timing. Finally, we show that inference engines can make model-
papers.summary: 今天的 agent 运行框架多半替模型管上下文：窗口满了就触发压缩，把历史摘要掉。另一种做法是让模型通过上下文接口自己决定何时压缩、压缩什么。对比是在 NVIDIA 开源框架 NOOA 里做的，任务包括文档研究和机器学习工程，上下文预算从很紧到很宽。能用好这套接口的模型往往更准，输入 token 也常常更少，预算紧时尤其明显：GPT 6.1 在 OfficeQA Pro v2 上的得分从 21% 提到 56%，几乎提高到原来的三倍。各模型调用频率、压缩力度和起步时机差得很远，改提示也会改变时机。推理引擎若复用编辑后未改后缀的 KV cache，单次请求的预填充计算最多可减 15%，准确度没有可测变化。

papers.title: nnTrace: Detecting and Localizing Silent Bugs in Distributed Training
papers.authors: Haitian Jiang, Shaowei Zhu, Zhen Zhang, Zhenyu Song, Xinwei Fu, Zhen Jia, Yida Wang, Jinyang Li
papers.abstract:
Distributed training is essential for scaling LLM training across thousands of GPUs. However, as distributed training requires complex implementations, they are prone to silent bugs, which do not produce explicit error signals but lead to in correct training outcomes. Common debugging practices based on monitoring training loss or gradient norm curves are slow or unable to detect bugs and also do not help localize bugs.

We design and implement nnTrace, the first systematic differential testing system for detecting and localizing silent bugs in distributed training. nnTrace aligns intermediate tensors from distributed training with those from a trusted reference implementation. To properly compare the floating-point values in the corresponding tensors, we propose a novel mathematical analysis that provides a guideline for setting tolerances, enabling nnTrace to distinguish bug-induced errors from numerical errors. Experimental results demonstrate that nnTrace effectively detects 11 exi
papers.summary: 大规模分布式训练要把计算摊到成千上万块 GPU 上，实现一复杂，就容易出现不报错、却把训练结果算错的静默缺陷。只看训练损失或梯度范数曲线，往往发现得慢，有时根本看不出来，更难以定位到出问题的地方。nnTrace 用差分测试来做检测和定位：把分布式训练过程中的中间张量，与一份可信的参考实现对齐，再比较对应位置的浮点值。关键是容忍差不能随便设，它给出一套数学分析，用来区分缺陷造成的误差和正常的数值误差。这样，检查才不会把舍入差异误判成缺陷，也不会把真正的静默错误放过去。对正在做大规模训练的人来说，先能指出错在哪一层、哪一个张量，比只看见曲线后来不对要有用得多。
